name: National Maritime Museum of China (国家海洋博物馆)
via: a public cultural institution co-built and co-managed by China's Ministry of Natural Resources and the Tianjin Municipal People's Government, directly under the Binhai New Area People's Government (museum's own profile, carried by Xinhua)
note: China's only national-level comprehensive maritime museum, in Tianjin's Binhai New Area. Its '国海博' wordmark is Tianjin Jinmen Tiger's 2026 chest sponsor (Tencent News, 17 March 2026).
